## Summary

Describe the behavior or maintenance concern addressed by this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] Ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] Ran `npm run verify:package` for package, export, type, or build changes.
- [ ] Updated rule documentation and README examples where behavior changed.
- [ ] Considered Windows, Node.js 22/24/26, and ESLint 8/9/10 compatibility.
- [ ] Used a Conventional Commit title.

## Release impact

- [ ] This change reports fewer lint errors and can be released as a patch.
- [ ] This change can report new lint errors and requires at least a minor release.
- [ ] This change drops compatibility or changes an established contract and is breaking.
- [ ] This change has no user-facing release impact.
